raw_packet.full_request:
덕테이프 포스터로 성인 대상 동네 건축 사진전과 공간 해설 행사를 안내해줘. 처음 오는 주민도 편하게 참여할 수 있고 건축과 빛을 관찰하는 즐거움이 느껴지게 해줘. 생활문화공간과 커뮤니티 디지털 화면에 쓰는 16:9 가로형으로 서로 다른 스타일 다섯 장을 만들어줘. 스타일은 맡길게. 건축 공간의 빛과 형태를 보는 사진전, 함께 듣는 공간 이야기가 하나의 행사로 연결되어 보이고 일정·장소·입장·신청·방문 안내가 읽혀야 해. 특정 실존 건물이나 기관의 홍보물로 보이지 않도록 해줘. 아래 문구만 각각 한 번씩 넣어줘.

procedure.method: Fresh independent session with no spawn, fork, resume or peer-review access. Read the pinned packet, literal case, rubric, review rules and compact method. Verified byte counts and SHA-256 pins. Packet source_assets and protected_layouts are both empty, so zero source opens and zero protected-layout reads apply; read all five pinned native-evidence manifests before poster viewing without following their embedded paths. Actually opened and visually inspected each of the 15 exact PNGs sequentially via tools.view_image with detail original and emitted the returned image to this session: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same view order. All 15 initial poster views preceded the first copy-reading/transcription stage, judgment and score. Retained first raw readings for all 55 copy entries. One genuine M4 title word-spacing ambiguity triggered one additional open of its exact pinned native view; both readings are retained and the ambiguity remains unresolved. Total actual poster image opens: 16, comprising the ordered 15 plus that one revisit. No sources or replacement assets were opened, no crops or images were generated or edited, and no session identity or serialized opening event was invented. Read-only PNG inspection confirmed RGB opacity and dimensions. Native 1672x941 is rounded rather than mathematically exact 16:9: abs(941-1672*9/16)=0.5, within the predeclared single-edge tolerance; usage720 is 720x405 and thumbnail320 is 320x180.

space.location: free/application left and visit/reassurance right above the band

Literal mandatory client conditions:

emotion_control.location: bright windows and readable invitation/advice

emotion_control.location: large graphic image compared with the upper text

ai_slop.observation: Repetition forms an intelligible architectural rhythm rather than random floating motifs. Window/light boundaries are clean, and there is no visible pseudo-label, watermark or accidental extra type.

residuals: Content_form is 3: the window/light motif is relevant but generic, with no nonglyph photo-display or discussion relationship; the specific combined event depends on the subtitle.

evidence.location: full-bleed room and four text zones
evidence.observation: The radiant central window and empty chairs carry the image over the whole page, with title low left and quieter information in wall/floor zones. Unlike M1/M3's boxed photography, the space itself supplies the text background and the emotional focus.

evidence.location: large left photograph, inset and oversized right schedule
evidence.observation: A dominant room photograph plus a smaller material/light detail gives a two-scale photographic study, with an orange title beneath the main photograph and a very large schedule above the right-side inset. It differs structurally from M2 but shares its window-and-sunlit-room subject and the heavier sans language of M1/M5.

evidence.location: central illustrated cutaway and flanking text
evidence.observation: The occupied isometric room is the central object, with headline/schedule at left and participation information at right, separated by thin rules. Exhibition, seats, speaker and open entry are visible together. This spatial diagram and balanced side columns differ from both the photographic posters and M5's horizontal image strip.

evidence.location: upper text columns and lower window/light band
evidence.observation: Information occupies a two-column cream upper field, while a navy/yellow perspective rhythm of windows and light shafts spans the lower band. This graphic abstraction has a different image/type role from M4's populated cutaway and M3's pair of photographs, although its bold headline/date pairing recalls M3.

evidence.location: comparison across the five complete layouts
evidence.observation: The differences include full-height panels, a full-image background, an image/inset grid, a central spatial illustration and a lower graphic band; they therefore go beyond palette or material substitution. A common heavy sans and repeated rectilinear window/light motifs still keep the range short of exceptional diversity.

residuals: All five use straightforward sans-serif information rows; four use very heavy headline and supporting weights, so typography provides less variety than composition and image role.

M2 and M3 repeat a quiet sunlit window/interior premise, and M5 repeats the window/light motif abstractly; their crops and information structures differ, but thematic image variety is narrower than the layout variety.
This is one independent portfolio assessment of the five pinned selected members, not a three-critic aggregate or a claim about other versions.

content_form.location: lower repeating-window band
content_form.observation: Windows and light shafts explain architecture/light in a general way, but the image contains no visible photograph exhibition, discussion or participant relationship. The specific exhibition-plus-space-talk event is carried almost entirely by the subtitle.

content_form.location: upper text field above the scene
content_form.observation: The large identity and schedule are functional, but the detachable window motif and two-column notice structure remain more generic than the content-linked guide/group scene in M1 or the integrated activity in M4.

hierarchy.location: title left, schedule right and image band below
hierarchy.observation: Identity and schedule are clear upper anchors; admission/application at left and venue/entry/advice at right are visibly grouped before the lower graphic scene.

hierarchy.location: whole poster
hierarchy.observation: The dark lettering and title/date scale persist, while the uninterrupted image band provides a distinct lower visual zone rather than another text competitor.

typography.location: title, schedule and support in the cream field
typography.observation: Hangul, English, centered dots and the time dash are intact; word spaces remain visible. A consistent heavy sans system handles the information without clipping.

typography.location: free-admission/application and reassurance groups
typography.observation: Even the smaller practical and welcoming lines remain directly readable above the image boundary.

space.location: upper two columns and lower band boundary
space.observation: The left and right text groups have clean alignment and margins, and the scene begins at a consistent horizontal boundary below them.

space.location: gaps between schedule, venue and advice
space.observation: Separated vertical groups keep the practical categories clear, while the substantial graphic strip balances the dense upper information.

image_material.observation: White bevel-like recesses, navy wall areas and yellow illumination use a consistent flat geometric language. Progressively scaled windows and cropped edge openings maintain a readable spatial rhythm.
Hard window boundaries and light shapes retain their construction after reduction without muddy texture or unreadable local clutter.

emotion_control.location: bright windows and readable invitation/advice
emotion_control.observation: The luminous yellow window field supplies energy and a sense of observing light, while practical advice and reassurance remain easy to find. The tone is adult and public-facing.

emotion_control.location: large graphic image compared with the upper text
emotion_control.observation: The limited palette and clean shapes control the intensity; the result is approachable, though less socially warm than M1/M4.

ai_slop.observation: Repetition forms an intelligible architectural rhythm rather than random floating motifs. Window/light boundaries are clean, and there is no visible pseudo-label, watermark or accidental extra type.
The image remains recognizable and orderly at small scale, rather than dissolving into arbitrary generated ornament.

residuals: Content_form is 3: the window/light motif is relevant but generic, with no nonglyph photo-display or discussion relationship; the specific combined event depends on the subtitle.
The common heavy sans and title-versus-date split echo M3, even though the continuous lower image band is a distinct composition.
The architectural rhythm is clear and deliberate, but the event's human welcome is carried chiefly by copy rather than by a social scene.
Native 1672×941 is accepted using the predeclared half-pixel height-rounding tolerance, not exact 16:9; QA views are 720×405 and 320×180.

evidence.location: whole split composition
evidence.observation: Two full-height colored panels divide schedule at left from title, a live exhibition/talk photograph and advice at right. This has a much more direct notice-board rhythm than M2's full-image atmosphere or M4's central room cutaway.

evidence.location: full-bleed room and four text zones
evidence.observation: The radiant central window and empty chairs carry the image over the whole page, with title low left and quieter information in wall/floor zones. Unlike M1/M3's boxed photography, the space itself supplies the text background and the emotional focus.

evidence.location: large left photograph, inset and oversized right schedule
evidence.observation: A dominant room photograph plus a smaller material/light detail gives a two-scale photographic study, with an orange title beneath the main photograph and a very large schedule above the right-side inset. It differs structurally from M2 but shares its window-and-sunlit-room subject and the heavier sans language of M1/M5.

evidence.location: central illustrated cutaway and flanking text
evidence.observation: The occupied isometric room is the central object, with headline/schedule at left and participation information at right, separated by thin rules. Exhibition, seats, speaker and open entry are visible together. This spatial diagram and balanced side columns differ from both the photographic posters and M5's horizontal image strip.

evidence.location: upper text columns and lower window/light band
evidence.observation: Information occupies a two-column cream upper field, while a navy/yellow perspective rhythm of windows and light shafts spans the lower band. This graphic abstraction has a different image/type role from M4's populated cutaway and M3's pair of photographs, although its bold headline/date pairing recalls M3.

evidence.location: comparison across the five complete layouts
evidence.observation: The differences include full-height panels, a full-image background, an image/inset grid, a central spatial illustration and a lower graphic band; they therefore go beyond palette or material substitution. A common heavy sans and repeated rectilinear window/light motifs still keep the range short of exceptional diversity.

residuals: All five use straightforward sans-serif information rows; four use very heavy headline and supporting weights, so typography provides less variety than composition and image role.

M2 and M3 repeat a quiet sunlit window/interior premise, and M5 repeats the window/light motif abstractly; their crops and information structures differ, but thematic image variety is narrower than the layout variety.
This is one independent portfolio assessment of the five pinned selected members, not a three-critic aggregate or a claim about other versions.
